title: OSError while opening the dashboard (migrate.apply)
body:
## Steps

To reproduce:
* Start by opening the dashboard.
* Run the app for a long session, then trigger the action.
* Check the log window; the traceback appears there.

## Environment

Lattice version 3.1.8; operating system Fedora 41
Workstation; server region eu-central-1.

## Actual

Only after hours of uptime does the failure appear. A long
session shows open files increasing without ever being
released.

## Frequency

Happens on about half the runs.

## Expected

No traceback; opening the dashboard normally takes a few
seconds.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:47 in loop
lattice/ui/view.py:210 in refresh
lattice/report/live.py:58 in tiles
lattice/store/migrate.py:229 in apply
OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device
